valueDescriptions.900001: %s surges forward: %d extra attack(s) this round.

AOM_ECHO.description:
{Divine Echo}
God powers have a chance to take effect once more.

valueDescriptions.1: Patron Temple: during sieges the Titan Cycle starts from the Aspect of the defending hero's patron god.

valueDescriptions.900001: Sky is ascendant: Sky Aspect troops are faster and deal +%d% damage this round.
valueDescriptions.900002: Time is ascendant: Time Aspect troops are faster and deal +%d% damage this round.
valueDescriptions.900003: Earth is ascendant: Earth Aspect troops are faster and deal +%d% damage this round.

valueDescriptions.900001: Sky and Time: the target bears both Sky Eye and Time Lag, so %s's attack ignores %d% of its Defense.
%s reaches %d stacks of Time Lag and is Timelocked.
%s is fully charged: the next hit deals +%d% damage.

valueDescriptions.900002: %s receives the boon of its guardian god: Favor %d.
valueDescriptions.900003: %s receives the power of the patron god: Favor %d.

valueDescriptions.900001: Focus: %s has %d Focus stacks on the same target, the next hit deals +%d% damage.
%s has stood still for %d rounds: allied shooters deal +%d% ranged damage.

valueDescriptions.1: Mythic Age: +10% Echo chance for the defending hero's god powers during sieges.
valueDescriptions.2: Wonder Age: +10% Echo chance for the defending hero's god powers during sieges, and +10% Hit Points for the garrison.

valueDescriptions.1: Return to Atlantis: %s drop from the sky (%d).
